notes: Forward elastic only; three timed repeats after one warmup. Errors are the maximum of component-wise max absolute error divided by that reference component's peak. Memory is the maximum across repeats; tracemalloc excludes native allocations, and RSS includes runtime overhead. Metal timing includes harness file I/O and process startup. Sizes and runtime targets are estimates, not measured on the reserved GPU.
